title: Pan-Seared Lamb Chops with French Flair
description: A French-inspired dish featuring lamb chops pan-seared to perfection, served with a side of springy vegetables.

ingredients.name: Springy vegetables (such as asparagus or bell peppers)

instructions: Preheat the Norwegian skillet over medium-high heat.
Season the lamb chops with salt and pepper.
Add a tablespoon of olive oil to the skillet and sear the lamb chops for 2-3 minutes per side.
Transfer the lamb chops to a plate and set aside to rest.
Add the remaining tablespoon of olive oil to the skillet and sauté the springy vegetables for 3-4 minutes.
Serve the lamb chops with the springy vegetables and a squeeze of zesty lemon juice.
